subject: Renewal & capacity increase — order form, billing, and data retention clarifications
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@evocorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — initial questions

Hi Camila,

Hope you’re well. We’re preparing to renew our Redwood subscription (current term ends 2028-11-15) and want to add a ~20% capacity uplift across the dedicated pool and move to a 24-month term if that helps with pricing. Procurement asked that I surface a few commercial/legal clarifications before we route a PO: 

- Can you confirm the billing cadence if we commit to a 24-month term and whether Evocorp can be invoiced quarterly vs monthly? Our AP requires PO on invoices.
- We need a clear data retention clause for inference logs and KV cache metadata (we typically require 24 months retention for auditability).
- Any material changes to indemnity or service exclusions in the latest MSA? We’d like SOC2 evidence and the most recent data processing addendum (DPA).

I attached our internal request summary. Happy to sync with legal or ops.

Thanks,
Alice Turner
Sr. Program Manager, ML Platforms
Evocorp
(Attachment: Evocorp_Renewal_Request_2028.pdf)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@evocorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-02T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — initial questions

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear summary. Long answer short: we can support an order that increases capacity and we frequently do quarterly invoicing for multi-year commitments, but I’ll need legal and sales-ops to confirm a couple of points (billing workflow and the precise retention language). Looping in Marissa (legal) and Karthik (sales ops) to propose concrete redlines.

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa: propose MSA/DPA edits (data retention + Exhibit for logs) and flag any material changes to indemnity/liability.
- Karthik: produce a draft order form with the 20% uplift, 24-month pricing, and quarterly invoice rows so Procurement can confirm PO workflow.
- Alice: if you can share Evocorp’s preferred PO template or the PO number format that will help speed AP processing.

I’ve added the HubSpot deal link here so we all have the same reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/EVOC-2028-RW-04

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Alice Turner <alice.turner@evocorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — initial questions (redlines)

Thanks for the loop, Camila. Alice — I reviewed the request and sketched targeted redlines rather than a full rewrite to keep this moving. High-level:

1) Data retention (new Exhibit F): propose we codify retention for "inference logs and KV metadata" at 24 months by default, with customer-configurable options and a note about legal holds. I’ve suggested sample language and a short preservation clause.

2) DPA & SOC2: we’ll attach the current DPA and provide a SOC2 Type II snapshot. These are standard deliverables; Karthik — can you confirm the latest SOC2 package we can share?

3) Indemnity / Limitation: There are no material changes from our public MSA, but I recommend keeping the existing commercial indemnity cap and adding a call-out that capacity increases do not expand liability beyond the MSA limits.

4) Billing cadence: if they want quarterly invoicing on a 24-month term, we need an Order Form appendix that lists invoice frequency, PO number field, and AP billing contact. We should confirm whether Evocorp requires net-30 vs net-45.

I attached a tracked-change redline of the MSA with the Exhibit F draft (see Redwood_MSA_redlines_2028.docx). Action items below.

Action items:
- Marissa: final redline and clean MSA + Exhibit F (target: 2028-10-05 EOD).
- Karthik: draft Order Form v3 with 20% uplift, 24-month pricing table, quarterly invoices, and AP fields (target: 2028-10-04 COB).
- Alice: confirm PO cadence (net terms) and upload PO template or sample.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_MSA_redlines_2028.docx)

On 2028-10-01T09:03:00-07:00 Alice Turner wrote:
> Hi Camila,
> 
> Hope you’re well. We’re preparing to renew our Redwood subscription (current term ends 2028-11-15) and want to add a ~20% capacity uplift...

From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@evocorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evocorp Procurement <procurement@evocorp.com>
Date: 2028-10-04T14:05:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — initial questions (PO and retention)

Thanks Marissa — that lineup makes sense. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Evocorp’s standard retention requirement for platform logs is 24 months, so Exhibit F at 24 months would be fine; we appreciate the legal hold language.
- Procurement requires the PO to be on file for each invoice. I’m attaching the PO reference for our initial approval flow (Evocorp_PO_12345.pdf).
- Our AP expects net-45 on multi-year agreements; is that workable for Redwood? If not, we can discuss escrow or staged prepayment.

If you can get a clean MSA with Exhibit F + the draft order form that includes a PO field and quarterly invoice rows, we’ll circulate to AP and legal for final sign-off.

Thanks,
Alice Turner
Sr. Program Manager, ML Platforms
Evocorp
(Attachment: Evocorp_PO_12345.pdf)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@evocorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-06T09:12:34-07:00
Subject: Summary & next steps — Evocorp renewal (order form and MSA)

Alice — great, thank you for confirming the PO and retention requirements. Quick summary of what we agreed and next steps so there’s a single source of truth: 

Agreed points:
- Capacity uplift: ~20% across dedicated pool, pricing updated for a 24-month commitment (Karthik to confirm final $ rows).
- Term: 24 months (customer preference), quarterly invoicing.
- Data retention: Exhibit F will specify 24 months for inference logs and KV metadata, with legal-hold exceptions.
- Billing: Evocorp will provide PO numbers on invoices; AP prefers net-45. Karthik — please note net-45 for finance to approve.

Owners & deliverables: 
- Marissa: produce final redline -> clean MSA + Exhibit F for signature (target: 2028-10-05 EOD; slipping to 10/06 is acceptable; please send as tracked changes and a clean PDF).
- Karthik: draft Order Form v3 (OrderForm_Evocorp_v3.pdf) with pricing, quarterly invoice rows, PO field, and AP contact lines (target: 2028-10-06 COB).
- Camila: I’ll get the DocuSign envelope ready once legal approves the redline. Proposed sign-by date: 2028-10-13.

If that matches Evocorp’s timeline, I’ll mark the HubSpot deal stage as Contracting + attach the final docs. Marissa/Karthik — if either of you foresee additional approvals (finance/treasury/legal), flag now so we don’t miss the sign-by date.

Thanks everyone — moving to action items in the thread.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: OrderForm_Evocorp_v3.pdf; DocuSign link to follow)
